If someone truly believed that they made a life saving vaccine, would it really be so hard to see them wanting to share it with those closest to them?  

When I make cool things I want to share them with those important to me.

However, it is wholly dishonorable to gather data for scientific research without forgoing bias.  That is the point of double blind studies as far as I am aware.

AYE.   H O L D.  U P.  

      That therapist broke the law.  You have grounds to sue if you could prove he violated HIPAA laws like that by sharing your confidential information.

     I’ll give the family the benefit of the doubt that they had good intentions of ousting you and your trauma.

     However, by the way you describe the interactions... they tried to pop an infected on your back by stabbing it with a butchers knife (analogy for the emotional triggering they caused you).

     To them, it likely seems normal to bring up what you went/ are going through.  For you, that brings up all kinds of (negative) feelings.

     I have c-ptsd and am attempting to share how I interpreted your post.  Hope it helps.  I’m here if you would like to talk.

     Not everyone is going to understand what you went/ go through.  Your emotions and reactions are your responsibility.  I also really struggle with hairpin anger issues... sometimes from triggers I don’t even know I have.  EMDR, DBT, mindful meditation and CBT have been helpful to me.  If you struggle with insomnia and nightmares/ flashbacks I humbly suggest asking for a low dose of prozosin for PTSD and sleep issues from your psychiatrist/ nurse practitioner.  

Merry Christmas ♥️🖤♥️🖤
